newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank says repo tender not needed on Tues.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank says repo tender not needed on Tues.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said it would not hold a tender for short-term securities repurchase on Tuesday as current liquidity in the banking sector did not require intervention.

"The NBS will not intervene today via repo operations. Considering liquidity developments...we did not consider refinancing nor sterilising tender as needed," Peter Andresic, head of the NBS's newly-established Open Market Operation Department, told Reuters.
